blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image denoising remains a fundamental problem in image restoration, with applications in photography, biomedical, and scientific imaging. Modern deep neural networks achieve strong performance by learning powerful image priors, but often rely on large black-box models with limited interpretability. In contrast, DCT-based sliding-window and collaborative filtering methods such as BM3D offer clear algorithmic structure, but depend on handcrafted and non-differentiable operations. This work studies how far such structured collaborative filtering principles can be pushed when reformulated as trainable models. We introduce DeepBM3D, a compact fully differentiable architecture that combines non-local patch grouping, DCT-domain filtering, and multi-stage refinement within a BM3D-inspired pipeline. Lightweight convolutional feature extractors guide patch grouping, while filtering is performed through learned Wiener weights in the DCT domain. Experiments show that DeepBM3D improves over classical and hybrid baselines, remains competitive with FFDNet at low and moderate noise levels, and performs particularly well on repetitive textures.
blocks.zh: 图像消音仍然是图像修复的一个根本问题,在摄影、生物医学和科学成像方面的应用。 现代深层神经网络通过学习强力图像前传,实现强性能,但往往依赖可解释性有限的大型黑盒模型. 相比之下,基于DCT的滑窗和BM3D等协作过滤方法提供了清晰的算法结构,但依赖于手工操作和无差别操作. 这项工作研究了这种结构化的协作过滤原则在重新制定为可训练模式时可在多大程度上得到推动。 我们引入了DeepBM3D,一种完全不同的紧凑架构,结合了非局部补丁分组,DCT域过滤,以及BM3D启发管内多阶段的完善. 轻量级演化特征提取器引导补丁组,而过滤则通过DCT域中学习到的Wiener权重进行. 实验显示,DeepBM3D比古典和混合基线改进,在低和中度噪音水平上仍然与FFDNet有竞争力,在重复纹理上表现特别出色.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image denoising is a long-standing problem in image processing and computer vision, fundamental to applications ranging from consumer photography to medical and scientific imaging.
The task consists of recovering a clean image from a noisy observation, a challenge that lies at the intersection of statistical estimation, signal modeling, and machine learning.
Classical methods based on sparsity and non-local redundancy, including transform-domain adaptive filtering approaches Yaroslavsky (1998) , Wiener filtering Lim (1990) , and collaborative filtering methods such as BM3D Dabov et al. (2007) , have remained reference points for decades thanks to their interpretability, efficiency, and strong performance despite relying on handcrafted priors.
These algorithms exploit structured operations such as transform-domain filtering, often relying on transforms like the DCT, together with patch grouping to leverage sparsity and self-similarity within natural images, providing a clear understanding of each processing stage.
blocks.zh:
图像消音是图像处理和计算机视觉中长期存在的问题,对于从消费摄影到医学和科学成像等各种应用都具有根本意义.
这项任务包括从吵闹的观察中恢复一个干净的图像,这一挑战存在于统计估计、信号建模和机器学习的交叉点。
基于垃圾和非局部冗余的经典方法,包括变形域适应性过滤方法Yaroslavsky(1998年),Wiener过滤Lim(1990年),以及诸如BM3D Dabov等人(2007年)等协作性过滤方法,由于这些方法的可解释性、效率和强效,尽管依赖手工前科,但几十年来一直保持着参考点。
这些算法利用了变形域滤波等结构化操作,往往依靠DCT等变形,加上补丁分组,在自然图像内发挥伸缩性和自我同质性的作用,为每个处理阶段提供了明确的理解.

blocks.en:
Deep learning has fundamentally changed the landscape of image restoration.
Modern convolutional and transformer-based models Zhang et al. (2017) ; Zhang et al. (2018) ; Zamir et al. (2022) learn powerful image priors directly from data, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse noise conditions and datasets.
However, these gains often come at the expense of interpretability and computational efficiency.
Typical networks contain millions of parameters and operate as black boxes, making their internal representations difficult to analyze or control.
In contrast, classical denoising pipelines offer a clear algorithmic structure and modularity, which explicitly separates the grouping, filtering, and aggregation stages.
blocks.zh:
深度学习从根本上改变了图像修复的景观.
现代转式和变压器型号 张等人 (2017年); 张等人 (2018年); 扎米尔等人 (2022年) 直接从数据中学习强力图像前传,实现跨不同噪声条件和数据集的最新性能.
然而,这些收益往往以可解释性和计算效率为代价。
典型的网络包含数百万个参数,并作为黑匣子运行,使其内部的表示难以分析或控制.
与此相反,古典的去诺化管道提供了明确的算法结构和模块化,它明确区分了分组,过滤,和聚合阶段.

blocks.en: This growing contrast has motivated renewed interest in models that bridge the gap between data-driven flexibility and the principled structure of traditional algorithms. Recent model-based and hybrid approaches Plötz and Roth (2018) ; Wang et al. (2018) ; Ye et al. (2024) have shown that it is possible to embed optimization principles and classical operations into trainable networks, combining interpretability with learning. In particular, Herbreteau et al. Herbreteau and Kervrann (2022) proposed DCT2Net, demonstrating that classical DCT-based denoising pipelines can benefit from learnable thresholding strategies.
blocks.zh: 这种越来越大的对比促使人们重新对弥合数据驱动的灵活性与传统算法的原则结构之间的差距的模型感兴趣。 最近的基于模型和混合方法Plötz和Roth(2018); Wang et al. (2018); Ye et al. (2024)已经表明,可以将优化原则和古典操作嵌入可训练网络,将可解释性和学习相结合. 特别是Herbreteau等. Herbreteau和Kervrann(2022年)提出DCT2Net,表明基于传统DCT的去诺化管道可以从可学习的阈值策略中获益.

blocks.en: Building upon these ideas, we propose DeepBM3D, a compact and fully differentiable architecture for collaborative transform-domain image denoising. DeepBM3D replaces handcrafted components commonly used in classical collaborative filtering pipelines with learnable and fully differentiable modules. Our model adopts a two-stage design and introduces lightweight convolutional modules to guide patch grouping and estimate transform-domain filtering weights in a trainable manner. This formulation enables gradient-based optimization across all stages while preserving the structural interpretability of collaborative filtering approaches.
blocks.zh: 基于这些想法,我们提出DeepBM3D,一个紧凑且完全不同的架构,用于协作变形域图像解析. DeepBM3D将古典合作滤管中常用的手工组件替换为可学习且完全不同的模块. 我们的模型采用两阶段设计,并引入轻量级演化模块,以可训练的方式指导补丁分组和估计变形域滤重. 这种提法使基于梯度的优化得以在所有阶段进行,同时保持协作过滤方法的结构解释性。

blocks.en: To preserve the underlying structure of classical collaborative filtering pipelines, we use a fixed DCT as transform and PSAL Cherel et al. (2024) , which performs differentiable patch matching. We explore two configurations: a lightweight version that already outperforms several classical and hybrid methods, and a heavier variant that approaches or exceeds FFDNet Zhang et al. (2018) , a representative CNN-based denoiser without explicit collaborative filtering constraints, in selected low and moderate noise settings.
blocks.zh: 为了保留古典合作过滤管道的基本结构,我们使用固定的DCT作为变换和PSAL Cherel等人(2024年),进行不同的补丁匹配. 我们探索两种配置:一种已经超过几种古典和混合方法的轻量级版本,另一种更重的变体接近或超过FFDNet Zhang等人(2018年),在选定的低度和中度噪声环境中,一个具有代表性的基于CNN的Denoiser没有明显的合作过滤限制.

blocks.en: Our results demonstrate that classical collaborative filtering principles, including non-local patch grouping and transform-domain Wiener filtering, can be effectively integrated within a fully differentiable and end-to-end trainable framework. The proposed architecture combines interpretability, modularity, and competitive denoising performance within a compact trainable model.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,传统的协作过滤原则,包括非局部补丁分组和变形域Wiener过滤,可以在完全不同的、端到端的可训练框架内有效整合。 拟议架构将可解释性、模块性、竞争性调试性能结合在一个紧凑的可训练模式内。

blocks.en:
The remainder of this paper is organized as follows.
Section 2 reviews related classical, deep, and hybrid denoising approaches.
Section 3 briefly summarizes the key principles of collaborative filtering as exemplified by BM3D Dabov et al. (2007) .
Section 4 presents our proposed DeepBM3D architecture.
Experimental setup and results are described in Sections 5 and 6 , respectively.
Finally, Section 7 concludes the paper and discusses future research directions.
blocks.zh:
本文件的其余部分编排如下。
第2节审查了相关的古典、深层和混合调试方法。
第3节简要总结了协作过滤的关键原则,BM3D Dabov等人(2007年)就是例证。
第4节介绍我们提议的DeepBM3D架构。
第5节和第6节分别介绍了实验设置和结果。
最后,第7节总结了该文件并讨论了今后的研究方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
This section reviews the main methodological trends shaping the evolution from classical signal processing and non-local filtering, through modern deep architectures, to hybrid frameworks that integrate optimization and learning.
Together, these developments motivate the development of structured, learnable denoising architectures that combine classical priors with deep learning.
blocks.zh:
本节回顾了塑造从古典信号处理和非局部过滤,通过现代深层架构,到融合优化和学习的混合框架的主要方法趋势.
这些发展共同推动了结构化,可学习的装饰建筑的发展,这些建筑结合了古典前科和深层学习.

blocks.en: 2.1 Classical Image Denoising Methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 古典图像除污方法

blocks.en:
Early image denoising methods relied on signal processing and statistical models that enforced sparsity, smoothness, or self-similarity.
Sliding DCT thresholding Yaroslavsky (1998) and Wavelet thresholding Donoho and Johnstone (1995) exploited sparsity of coefficients to suppress noise while preserving edges, whereas dictionary-learning methods such as K-SVD Aharon et al. (2006) represented patches as sparse combinations of learned atoms, later extended through online learning for scalability Mairal et al. (2009) .
The Non-Local Means (NLM) algorithm Buades et al. (2005) introduced the idea of self-similarity by averaging non-local patches with similarity-based weights, a principle refined by the Non-Local Bayes model Lebrun et al. (2013) , which framed patch grouping and filtering in a Bayesian setting.
Low-rank modeling further generalized these ideas by assuming that groups of similar patches form low-rank matrices.
Weighted Nuclear Norm Minimization (WNNM) Xie et al. (2014) ; Gu et al. (2014) formalized this as a convex optimization problem with adaptive weighting of singular values, effectively linking patch grouping and sparse representation.
blocks.zh:
早期的图像消音方法依赖于信号处理和统计模型,这些模型可以强制施压,平滑,或自我同化.
滑动的DCT阈值Yaroslavsky(1998年)和Wavelet阈值Donoho和Johnstone(1995年)利用系数的伸缩性来抑制噪音,同时保护边缘,而K-SVD Aharon等人(2006年)等词典学习方法则代表着零星的学习原子组合,后来通过在线学习扩展为可伸缩性Mairal等人(2009年)。
非本地手段(NLM)算法 Buades等人(2005年)提出了通过平均非本地补丁的类似加权值来进行自我同化的理念,非本地贝叶斯模型Lebrun等人(2013年)完善了这一原则,该原则在贝叶斯语环境中设定了补丁分组和过滤.
低阶模型通过假设类似补丁组组成低阶矩阵来进一步概括这些想法.
加权核规范最小化(WNNM) Xie等人(2014年);Gu等人(2014年)将这一点正式确定为对流优化问题,即单值的适应性加权,有效地将补丁分组和代表物稀少联系起来。

blocks.en:
Other frameworks approached denoising from a probabilistic viewpoint.
The Expected Patch Log Likelihood (EPLL) model Zoran and Weiss (2011) used Gaussian mixture models to describe natural image patches, achieving strong generalization across noise levels, while the Wiener filter Lim (1990) provided a theoretical foundation for optimal linear denoising under Gaussian assumptions.
Among these approaches, collaborative filtering methods based on non-local patch grouping and transform-domain sparsity have proven particularly effective.
A prominent example is the Block-Matching and 3D Filtering (BM3D) algorithm Dabov et al. (2007) ; Lebrun (2012) , which combines non-local grouping, transform-domain filtering, and patch aggregation in a unified multi-stage process.
BM3D’s success lies in exploiting both non-local redundancy and transform-domain sparsity, yielding highly competitive results even compared to modern learning-based models.
Extensions such as BM3D-PCA Dabov et al. (2009) and BM4D Maggioni et al. (2013) adapted the framework to data-dependent bases and volumetric signals.
However, the reliance on handcrafted transforms and hard block matching limits adaptability, motivating the transition toward trainable and fully differentiable alternatives.
blocks.zh:
其他框架则从概率角度出发。
期望补丁日志Iliclihood(EPLL)模型Zoran和Weiss(2011年)使用高斯混合模型描述自然图像补丁,实现了强烈的跨噪声水平的泛化,而Wiener滤波器Lim(1990年)为高斯假设下的最佳线性解析提供了理论基础.
在这些方法中,基于非局部补丁分组和变形域伸缩性的协作过滤方法已证明特别有效。
一个突出的例子是Block-Matching和3D Filtering(BM3D)算法Dabov等人(2007年);Lebrun (2012),该算法结合了非局部分组,变形域过滤,以及一个统一的多阶段过程中的补丁聚合.
BM3D的成功在于既利用非本地冗余性,又利用变形域伸缩性,即使与现代的学习模式相比,也会产生高度竞争的结果.
BM3D-PCA Dabov等人(2009年)和BM4D Maggioni等人(2013年)等扩展版本根据数据依赖基础和量子信号对框架进行了调整.
然而,对手工改造和硬块匹配的依赖限制了适应性,推动了向可训练和完全不同的替代品的过渡。

blocks.en: 2.2 Learning-Based Denoisers: From CNNs to Transformers
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于学习的Denoisers:从有线电视新闻网到变形器

blocks.en:
Deep learning methods replaced image priors with learned representations, enabling powerful data-driven denoising.
Early neural approaches used multilayer perceptrons Burger et al. (2012) , but convolutional neural networks (CNNs) soon became dominant due to their parameter sharing and spatial locality.
DnCNN Zhang et al. (2017) pioneered residual learning by predicting the noise component instead of the clean image, and FFDNet Zhang et al. (2018) incorporated a noise-level map to handle spatially variant noise with a single model.
MemNet Tai et al. (2017) introduced memory blocks to retain contextual information across layers, and subsequent works generalized these ideas to diverse restoration tasks.
blocks.zh:
深层的学习方法用学到的表示代替了图像前缀,使得强大的数据驱动去诺化成为可能.
早期神经方法使用多层知觉器Burger等人(2012年),但由于参数共享和空间位置,进化神经网络(CNN)很快成为主流.
DnCNN (丹麦语) 张等人(2017年)率先通过预测噪声成分而不是清真图像来进行残留学习,而FFDNet张等人(2018年)则采用了噪声级地图,用单一模型处理空间变异噪声.
MemNet Tai et al. (2017)引入了内存块来保留跨层的上下文信息,随后的作品将这些想法概括为多种修复任务.

blocks.en:
Self-supervised and unsupervised paradigms addressed the scarcity of clean training data.
Noise2Noise Lehtinen et al. (2018) demonstrated that denoisers can be trained using only pairs of noisy images, while Noise2Void Krull et al. (2019) and Noise2Self Batson and Royer (2019) extended this principle to single-image denoising through pixel masking strategies.
These methods significantly broadened the applicability of deep denoising in real-world imaging scenarios.
blocks.zh:
自我监督和不受监督的范例解决了清洁培训数据的稀缺问题。
Noise2 Noise Lehtinen等人(2018年)证明,德诺瓦斯人只能使用噪音图像的对子进行训练,而Noise2Void Krull等人(2019年)和Noise2Solf Batson和Royer(2019年)则将这一原则扩展至通过像素遮盖策略的单像素去诺.
这些方法大大扩展了在现实世界成像情景中深层打假的适用性。

blocks.en:
The encoder–decoder architecture introduced by U-Net Ronneberger et al. (2015) became the foundation for most CNN-based denoisers.
Variants such as RIDNet Anwar and Barnes (2019) , DDUNet Jia et al. (2021) , and SADNet Chang et al. (2020) integrated attention mechanisms, dense connectivity, and spatial adaptivity to enhance feature representation.
Later architectures like MPRNet Zamir et al. (2021) , HINet Chen et al. (2022a) , and NAFNet Chen et al. (2022b) employed multi-stage refinement and improved normalization for higher efficiency and stability.
These advances consolidated CNNs as the standard for high-quality image restoration.
Beyond task-specific CNNs, general-purpose denoisers such as DRUNet Zhang et al. (2022) have been proposed as flexible modules that can serve both as standalone restoration networks and as plug-and-play priors for a wide range of inverse problems.
This design demonstrates how a single deep architecture can act as a universal regularizer, bridging traditional optimization frameworks and data-driven learning.
blocks.zh:
由U-Net Ronneberger等人(2015年)推出的编码器-编码器架构成为了大多数基于CNN的Denoisers的基础.
例如RIDNet Anwar和Barnes(2019年)、DDUNet Jia等人(2021年)和SADNet Chang等人。 (2020)集成关注机制,密集互联互通,空间适配性增强特色代表性.
后期建筑如MPRNet Zamir等人(2021年),HINet Chen等人(2022年a年),NAFNet Chen等人(2022年b年b年)采用多阶段改进和改进正常化,以提高效率和稳定性.
这些进步巩固了CNN作为高质量图像修复的标准.
除了针对特定任务的CNN外,还提出了DRUNet Zhang等人(2022年)等通用解码器作为灵活的模块,既可作为独立的恢复网络,又可作为各种反向问题的插头和播放前奏.
这一设计表明,一个单一的深层建筑如何能够发挥通用的规范化作用,连接传统的优化框架和数据驱动的学习。

blocks.en:
Transformers extended this progress by modeling long-range dependencies.
SwinIR Liang et al. (2021) builds upon the Swin Transformer Liu et al. (2021) architecture, adapting its shifted-window self-attention mechanism for efficient and scalable image restoration.
Restormer Zamir et al. (2022) and Uformer Wang et al. (2022) further extend this paradigm by combining hierarchical attention with U-shaped architectures, enabling global context modeling while preserving spatial precision.
blocks.zh:
变形器通过建模长距离依赖性来延长这一进展.
SwinIR Liang et al. (2021)以Swin Transformer Liu et al. (2021)建筑为基础,调整了其转向窗口自留机制,以高效和可伸缩的图像修复.
Restormer Zamir等人(2022年)和Uformer Wang等人(2022年)进一步扩展了这一范式,将等级关注与U形建筑相结合,在保持空间精度的同时促成全球背景建模.

blocks.en:
FFTFormer Pei et al. (2025) further bridged spatial and frequency domains, and DnT Liu et al. (2022) proposed an unsupervised transformer-based denoiser.
Together, these models demonstrate a shift from explicit priors to hierarchical learned representations.
More recently, diffusion-based generative models have also been adapted for image restoration.
SR3 Saharia et al. (2023) formulates super-resolution as an iterative denoising process, showing that diffusion mechanisms can progressively refine images toward high-fidelity reconstructions.
Although primarily developed for generative tasks, these models highlight the close conceptual link between denoising and iterative refinement.
Efficiency-oriented designs, such as EfficientNet Tan and Le (2019) , also influenced modern lightweight denoisers for mobile and real-time applications.
blocks.zh:
FFTFormer Pei等人(2025年)进一步搭桥空间和频率域,DnT Liu等人. (2022年)提议采用无人监督的变压器制式Denoiser.
这些模式共同表明,从明确的前科转向分级学习的表述。
最近,还修改了基于传播的基因模型,以恢复图像。
SR3 Saharia等人(2023年)将超解作为迭代解析过程,表明传播机制可以逐步完善图像,实现高真性重建.
虽然这些模型主要是为基因任务而开发的,但强调去名化和迭代完善之间的紧密概念联系.
以效率为导向的设计,如"效率网 Tan"和"Le"(2019年),也影响了现代轻量级脱衣舞女郎的移动和实时应用.

blocks.en: 2.3 Model-Based Deep Learning and Hybrid Paradigms
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于模式的深入学习和混合模式

blocks.en:
Model-based deep learning seeks to combine interpretability with learning capacity by embedding optimization principles into neural architectures.
Algorithm unrolling Gregor and LeCun (2010) first showed that sparse coding inference can be approximated through a fixed-depth network, inspiring frameworks such as ADMM-Net Yang et al. (2017) and ADMM-CSNet Yang et al. (2020) , which unroll iterative solvers for compressive sensing and MRI.
Similarly, TNRD Chen and Pock (2017) learned parameters of PDE-based diffusion processes, linking deep networks and variational models.
Plug-and-Play (PnP) Venkatakrishnan et al. (2013) and Regularization by Denoising (RED) Romano et al. (2017) further connected classical optimization with deep priors, treating denoisers as implicit regularizers.
Related approaches learned explicit proximal operators Meinhardt et al. (2017) or exploited network structure as an implicit prior, as in Deep Image Prior Lempitsky et al. (2018) .
blocks.zh:
基于模型的深层学习试图通过将优化原则嵌入神经架构,将可解释性和学习能力结合起来.
算法不滚动Gregor和LeCun(2010年)首先表明,稀有的编码推论可以通过一个固定的深度网络来进行近似,激发了ADMM-Net Yang等人(2017年)和ADMM-CSNet Yang等人(2020年)等框架,这些框架为压缩感知和核磁共振解脱滚动迭代解.
类似地,TNRD Chen and Pock (2017)学习了基于PDE的传播过程的参数,将深层网络和变异模型联系起来.
Plug-and-Play(PnP) Venkatakrishnan等人(2013年)和Denoising(RED)Romano等人的规范化(2017年)进一步将古典优化与深前科联系起来,将denoiser视为隐含的规范化者.
所学相关方法明确指近缘操作者 Meinhardt等人(2017年)或将网络结构作为隐含的先行结构加以利用,如Deep Image Prior Lempitsky等人(2018年).

blocks.en:
Hybrid architectures integrate classical operations directly within neural frameworks.
BM3D-Net Yang and Sun (2018) and DCT2Net Herbreteau and Kervrann (2022) emulate transform-domain filtering, while BMCNN Ahn et al. (2018) incorporates block-matching as a learnable stage.
Differentiable non-local modules such as N3Net Plötz and Roth (2018) , Non-Local Networks Wang et al. (2018) , and Dual Attention Fu et al. (2019) generalize patch similarity into attention mechanisms, later extended by PSAL Cherel et al. (2024) , which performs differentiable approximate nearest-neighbor matching via stochastic attention.
Low-rank priors have also been integrated into deep unrolled architectures, as in HLR-DUR Shao et al. (2024) and ILRNet Ye et al. (2024) , bridging low-rank modeling and deep optimization.
Recent reviews Su et al. (2022) ; Elad et al. (2023) summarize this convergence between classical and deep paradigms, emphasizing that denoisers can serve as flexible priors for inverse problems.
blocks.zh:
混合结构将古典操作直接融合在神经框架内.
BM3D-Net Yang and Sun (2018),DCT2Net Herbreteau and Kervrann (2022) 模拟变形域过滤,而BMCNN Ahn等人 (2018) 则将区块比对作为可学习的阶段.
N3Net Plötz和Roth(2018年),非本地化等不同非本地化模块 Networks Wang et al. (2018),和Dual Region Fu et al. (2019) 将补丁相似性概括成关注机制,后来由PSAL Cherel et al. (2024) 扩展,它们通过stochtic attention进行不同近邻匹配.
低等级前身也被整合到深层未滚动的建筑中,如HLR-DUR Shao等人(2024年)和ILRNet Ye等人(2024年),连接低等级模型和深度优化.
最近的审查 Su等人(2022年),Elad等人著. (2023年)总结了古典范式和深层范式之间的这种趋同,强调德诺瓦人可以作为反向问题的灵活前奏.

blocks.en: 2.4 Learning Collaborative Transform-Domain Denoising
blocks.zh: 2.4 学习合作变革领域

blocks.en:
Collaborative filtering methods based on non-local patch grouping and transform-domain sparsity have long been central to classical image denoising, with BM3D Dabov et al. (2007) ; Lebrun (2012) representing one of the most influential examples.
These approaches inspired several attempts to integrate their principles within learnable frameworks.
Methods such as BM3D-Net Yang and Sun (2018) and BMCNN Ahn et al. (2018) introduce neural components into collaborative filtering pipelines, while still relying on fixed or non-differentiable stages.
Other works focus on learning individual components of these pipelines: DCT2Net Herbreteau and Kervrann (2022) learns interpretable transform-domain filters, N3Net Plötz and Roth (2018) approximates patch matching through attention mechanisms, and PSAL Cherel et al. (2024) performs differentiable patch grouping via stochastic attention.
blocks.zh:
基于非局部补丁组和变形域的协同过滤方法长期以来一直是古典图像解析的核心,BM3D Dabov等人(2007年);Lebrun (2012)代表最有影响力的例子之一.
这些方法激励了将这些原则纳入可学习框架的几次尝试。
BM3D-Net Yang和Sun(2018年),BMCNN Ahn等人(2018年)等方法将神经元引入协作过滤管道,同时仍然依赖固定或无区别的阶段.
其他作品侧重于学习这些管线的单个组件:DCT2Net Herbreteau和Kervrann (2022)学习可解释的变形域滤波器,N3Net Plötz和Roth (2018)通过注意机制大致对接补丁,PSAL Cherel 等人 (2024)通过分解的注意来进行不同的补丁分组.

blocks.en:
These developments highlight the potential of combining non-local similarity, transform-domain filtering, and deep learning within unified architectures.
Building on these ideas, the proposed DeepBM3D integrates non-local patch grouping and collaborative transform-domain filtering into a fully differentiable and trainable framework, enabling end-to-end learning while preserving the structural principles of classical collaborative denoising methods.
blocks.zh:
这些发展凸显了结合非局部相似性,变形域过滤,在统一架构内深入学习的潜力.
基于这些想法,拟议的DeepBM3D将非局部补丁组和协作变形域过滤器整合到一个完全不同且可训练的框架,使得端到端的学习成为可能,同时保留了古典合作除名方法的结构原理.

blocks.en: 3 Key Principles of BM3D
blocks.zh: 3. BM3D的关键原则

blocks.en:
Block-Matching and 3D Filtering (BM3D) Dabov et al. (2007) ; Lebrun (2012) is a classical image denoising algorithm that exploits non-local self-similarity through collaborative filtering in a transform domain.
In this section we briefly summarize the key principles of BM3D that are relevant for understanding the proposed architecture.
blocks.zh:
区块匹配和三维过滤(BM3D) Dabov等人(2007年);Lebrun (2012)是一个古典的图像解析算法,它通过在变形域中的合作过滤来利用非本地自我同化.
在本节中,我们简要总结了BM3D与理解拟议架构相关的关键原则。

blocks.en:
Let Y = X + η Y=X+\eta denote the observed noisy image, where X X is the clean image and η ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ 2 ) \eta\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^{2}) is additive white Gaussian noise.
BM3D operates by grouping similar patches, applying collaborative filtering in a transform domain, and aggregating the resulting estimates.
blocks.zh:
让 Y = X + η YQQQeta 表示所观察到的噪音图像, 其中 X X 是干净的图像, \\ N \\ (0, \ 2)\ eta\sim\ mathcal{ N} (0,\sigma\ 2}) 是添加的白色高斯噪音 。
BM3D通过分组相似的补丁来操作,在变形域中应用协作过滤,并汇总由此产生的估计.

blocks.en:
Patch Grouping For each reference patch extracted from the noisy image, BM3D searches within a spatial window to identify a set of similar patches according to an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance.
These patches are stacked together to form a 3D group, exploiting the observation that similar structures often recur across an image.
blocks.zh:
补丁分组 对于从噪音图像中提取的每个参考补丁,BM3D在一个空间窗口内搜索,以按照l 2\ell\2}距离识别一组类似的补丁.
这些补丁被堆叠在一起形成一个3D组,利用类似结构经常在图像中重复的观察.

blocks.en:
Collaborative Transform-Domain Filtering Each group is processed using a separable 3D transform that combines a 2D transform applied to each patch and a 1D transform across the group dimension.
Noise is suppressed by shrinking transform coefficients, either through hard thresholding or Wiener filtering, before applying the inverse transform to reconstruct denoised patches.
blocks.zh:
合作变形域过滤 每个组采用可分离的3D变换处理,将适用于每个补丁的2D变换和跨组维的1D变换结合起来.
在应用逆变重建去诺化补丁之前,通过硬阈值或Wiener过滤,通过收缩变换系数抑制噪声.

blocks.en:
Aggregation The filtered patches are returned to their original image locations.
Because patches overlap, multiple estimates contribute to each pixel.
A weighted averaging strategy aggregates these contributions, producing the final restored image.
blocks.zh:
合计 被过滤的补丁返回到其原始图像位置.
由于补丁重叠,多个估计对每个像素都有贡献.
加权平均战略汇总了这些捐款,产生了最终恢复的形象。

blocks.en:
BM3D performs this procedure in two successive stages: a first stage based on hard-thresholding to obtain a basic estimate, followed by a second stage that refines the result using Wiener filtering guided by the basic estimate.
These principles of non-local patch grouping, transform-domain collaborative filtering, and aggregation form the conceptual foundation for the architecture proposed in this work.
blocks.zh:
BM3D连续两个阶段完成这个程序:第一阶段基于硬推力以获得一个基本估计,然后第二阶段通过以基本估计为指南的Wiener过滤来完善结果.
这些非局部补丁分组,变形域合作过滤,以及聚合等原则构成了本作品中提议的架构的概念基础.

blocks.en: 4 DeepBM3D Architecture
blocks.zh: 4 深BM3D 架构

blocks.en:
We introduce DeepBM3D , a lightweight end-to-end trainable architecture for collaborative transform-domain image denoising.
The proposed model integrates non-local patch grouping, transform-domain collaborative filtering, and aggregation within a unified differentiable framework.
Its design is guided by the structural principles of classical collaborative filtering methods, including BM3D, with trainable modules that enable data-driven optimization.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了DeepBM3D,一种轻量级的端对端可训练架构,用于协作变形域图像解析.
拟议的模式将非局部补丁分组,变形域协作过滤,汇总整合到一个统一的不同框架内.
其设计遵循了包括BM3D在内的古典合作过滤方法的结构原理,带有可训练模块,能够实现数据驱动优化.

blocks.en:
DeepBM3D adopts a two-stage architecture that follows the progressive refinement strategy commonly used in classical denoising pipelines.
In this design, three key operations are implemented as differentiable modules: patch grouping is achieved through an attention-based mechanism (PSAL Cherel et al. (2024) ), collaborative filtering is performed via learned Wiener weights in the DCT domain, and the 3D transform is implemented as a linear layer.
In addition, compact CNN-based feature extractors are employed to guide the grouping process and enhance representational power.
A visual comparison between BM3D and DeepBM3D is shown in Figure 1 .
Overall, this yields a modular and interpretable architecture that combines the structural principles of collaborative filtering with the flexibility of deep learning.
blocks.zh:
DeepBM3D采用双阶段架构,遵循古典脱口管道常用的渐进完善策略.
在这个设计中,有三种关键操作作为不同的模块执行:补丁分组通过一个基于注意力的机制实现(PSAL Chherel et al. (2024)),通过DCT域中学习到的Wiener权重进行协作过滤,3D转换作为线性层执行.
此外,还采用有线电视新闻网的紧凑功能提取器来指导分组过程,增强代表能力。
BM3D和DeepBM3D的视觉比较见图1。
总的来说,这产生了模块化和可解释的架构,将协作过滤的结构原则与深度学习的灵活性结合起来.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.2 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
The learned modules in DeepBM3D are designed to be lightweight while retaining interpretability.
All convolutional layers employ 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernels with reflect padding to mitigate boundary artifacts, followed by ReLU activations unless otherwise noted.
blocks.zh:
DeepBM3D中学习的模块设计为轻量级,同时保留可解释性.
所有演化层均采用3×3 3\时的3个内核,并带有反射垫以缓解边界文物,除另有说明外,再采用ReLU激活.

blocks.en:
Feature extractors DeepBM3D relies on three small CNNs that share a common architecture (see Figure 2 ) but serve distinct roles:
(i) the image-level extractor ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} , which operates on the concatenation of the noisy image and the noise map;
(ii) the spatial-domain extractor ψ θ img \psi_{\theta}^{\text{img}} , applied to grouped patches in the pixel domain;
and (iii) the transform-domain extractor ψ θ dct \psi_{\theta}^{\text{dct}} , applied to grouped patches in the DCT domain.
Each extractor follows the structure Conv 3 × 3 → 3\times 3\rightarrow Conv 3 × 3 → 3\times 3\rightarrow Conv 3 × 3 3\times 3 , with reflect padding and ReLU activations after each convolution.
The output dimensionality of ϕ θ \phi_{\theta} is controlled by n features n_{\text{features}} , while ψ θ img \psi_{\theta}^{\text{img}} and ψ θ dct \psi_{\theta}^{\text{dct}} produce N ⋅ m N\cdot m features, where N N is the number of grouped patches and m m a capacity multiplier.
Two configurations are considered: • light: n features = 32 n_{\text{features}}=32 , m = 4 m=4 . • heavy: n features = 64 n_{\text{features}}=64 , m = 8 m=8 .

Block matching Patch grouping is implemented with the differentiable PSAL operator Cherel et al. (2024) .
Patch similarity is computed on learned features, while the grouped patches are drawn from either the noisy image Y Y or the first-stage estimate x ^ ( 1 ) \hat{x}^{(1)} .
This ensures that reconstruction is always grounded in the input, while gradients propagate through the selection mechanism.
The number of candidates is C C , plus the reference patch, yielding N = C + 1 N=C+1 patches per group.
In practice, we use patch size k = 5 k=5 , and N = 16 N=16 candidates.

3D transforms Groups are processed with separable 2D+1D DCT/IDCT operators implemented as fixed, non-trainable linear layers.
This retains the transform-domain formulation commonly used in collaborative filtering methods, while ensuring differentiability and a low parameter count.

三维变换 组由可分离的2D+1D DCT/IDCT操作器进行处理,作为固定的,不可训练的线性层执行.
这保留了协作过滤方法中常用的变形域配方,同时确保了差异性和低参数计数.

blocks.en:
Wiener weights Collaborative filtering is parameterized by two identical CNNs, ω θ ( 1 ) \omega_{\theta}^{(1)} and ω θ ( 2 ) \omega_{\theta}^{(2)} , which estimate elementwise weights for Stage 1 and Stage 2, respectively.
Each network follows the structure
Conv 3 × 3 → 3\times 3\rightarrow Conv 3 × 3 → 3\times 3\rightarrow Conv 1 × 1 → 1\times 1\rightarrow Conv 1 × 1 → 1\times 1\rightarrow Conv 1 × 1 → 1\times 1\rightarrow Conv 3 × 3 → 3\times 3\rightarrow sigmoid,
with ReLU activations between convolutional layers and reflect padding to reduce boundary artifacts. The full architecture is shown in Figure 3 .
Outputs are bounded in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by the final sigmoid activation but are not normalized across candidates, granting the model additional flexibility.
Both DeepBM3D-light and DeepBM3D-heavy use this same structure, differing only in their respective multipliers ( m = 4 m=4 and m = 8 m=8 ).

Aggregation We adopt reference patch replacement. Each denoised reference patch substitutes its noisy counterpart, and overlapping contributions are averaged.
Alternative schemes, such as weighted overlapping or central-pixel aggregation, were tested but did not improve results.

测试了加权重叠或中央像素聚合等替代方案,但没有改进结果。

blocks.en: Inference To enhance robustness and reduce boundary artifacts, the model processes the image in a sliding-window fashion over overlapping patches. For a patch size of 64 × 64 64\times 64 , we use a stride of 4 during evaluation, although good results are also obtained with stride 32. The outputs of overlapping regions are merged using simple averaging. In practice, the formulation above applies equally whether Y Y denotes a full image or an individual patch.
blocks.zh: 推论 为了增强坚固性和减少边界文物,模型以滑窗方式处理图像,而不是重叠的补丁。 对于64×64 64\times 64的补丁尺寸,我们在评价时使用4步,虽然也以32步获得良好结果. 重叠区域的产出采用简单的平均法加以合并。 在实践中,无论YY表示完整的图像还是单个的补丁,上述表述都同等适用.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: We describe the experimental protocol used to evaluate DeepBM3D, including the datasets and noise configurations, training procedure, and baseline methods used for comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们描述了用于评价DeepBM3D的实验协议,包括数据集和噪声配置,训练程序和用于比较的基准方法.

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets and Noise Settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集和噪音设置

blocks.en: To train and validate our models, we construct a grayscale dataset by combining images from DIV2K Agustsson and Timofte (2017) , Flickr2K Lim et al. (2017) , and the Waterloo Exploration Database Ma et al. (2017) . All images are converted to grayscale, resulting in a fixed split of 7,969 training images and 292 validation images, which is used consistently across all experiments. During training, random crops of size 64 × 64 64\times 64 are sampled from these images at each epoch and used as input patches. In addition, data augmentation is applied in the form of random horizontal and vertical flips, as well as random 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} rotations, to improve generalization. This dataset is used exclusively for training and validation.
blocks.zh: 为了训练和验证我们的模型,我们通过合并DIV2K Agustsson和Timofte(2017年)、Flick2K Lim等人(2017年)和滑铁卢勘探数据库Ma等人(2017年)的图像,构建了一个灰度数据集。 所有图像都转换成灰色尺度,结果固定分拆出7,969个训练图像和292个验证图像,在所有实验中一致使用. 在训练期间,从每个时代的这些图像中抽取64×64 64\时的随机作物,用作输入补丁。 此外,数据增强还采用随机水平翻转和垂直翻转的形式,以及随机90QQ90QCirc}旋转,以提高概括性. 该数据集专门用于培训和验证。

blocks.en: For testing, we follow common practice and evaluate on four standard benchmarks: BSD100 Martin et al. (2001) , Kodak Loui et al. (2007) , McMaster (McM) Wu et al. (2011) , and Set14 Zeyde et al. (2012) . These datasets provide a diverse range of content and are widely adopted for denoising evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了测试,我们遵循惯例,并按四个标准基准进行评估:BSD100 Martin等人(2001年)、Kodak Loui等人(2007年)、McMaster(McM) Wu等人(2011年)和Set14 Zeyde等人(2012年)。 这些数据集提供了多种内容,并被广泛采用,用于去名评价.

blocks.en: Noise is synthetically applied as additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN). During flexible training phases (see Section 5.2 ), noise levels σ \sigma are sampled uniformly from the interval [ 0 , 50 ] [0,50] . For evaluation, we report results at fixed noise levels σ ∈ { 5 , 15 , 25 , 35 } \sigma\in\{5,15,25,35\} , which are standard in the denoising literature. All noise realizations are generated using a fixed random seed to ensure reproducibility, so that test conditions are identical across runs.
blocks.zh: 噪声作为添加剂白高斯噪音(AWGN)被合成应用. 在灵活培训阶段(见第5.2节),从[0、50][0、50]的间隔点对噪音水平进行统一取样。 为了评价,我们报告固定噪音水平的结果 \\\ { 5, 15, 25, 35}\sigma\in\ 5, 15, 25, 35\\ ,这是去诺文学的标准。 所有噪声实现都使用固定的随机种子生成,以确保可复制性,因此测试条件在跨运行时相同.

blocks.en: 5.2 Training Details
blocks.zh: 5.2 培训细节

blocks.en:
We adopt a three-phase training scheme to optimize both generalization and performance across noise levels.
All models are trained end-to-end using an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss on the final output x ^ ( 2 ) \hat{x}^{(2)} .
Optimization is performed with Adam ( lr = 10 − 4 , β 1 = 0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \text{lr}=10^{-4},\beta_{1}=0.9,\beta_{2}=0.999 ), using an effective batch size of 16.
Training is conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU (48 GB).
blocks.zh:
我们采取了一个三阶段的培训计划,以优化一般化和各种噪音的性能。
所有模型都使用 l1\ell\% 1} 最终输出损失 x^ (2)\ hat{x}(2)} 来训练端到端 。
优化由亚当(lr = 10 − 4,β 1 = 0.9,β 2 = 0.999\text{lr}=10^{-4},\βa_{1}=0.9,\βa_{2}=0.999)进行,有效批量尺寸为16.
培训内容为单一NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU(48 GB).

blocks.en:
During training, input patches are sampled dynamically from the training images.
At each epoch, random 64 × 64 64\times 64 crops are drawn from randomly selected images, so that only a subset of the dataset is seen per epoch.
This stochastic sampling strategy effectively exposes the model to a large diversity of patches across epochs while keeping each epoch computationally lightweight.
blocks.zh:
在培训期间,从培训图像中动态抽取输入补丁。
每个纪元时,随机64×64 64\时从随机选择的图像中抽取64个庄稼,因此每个纪元只看到数据集的一个子集.
这种划时代的采样策略有效地将模型暴露在跨世纪的众多的补丁中,同时保持每个划时代的计算轻量级.

blocks.en:
• Phase 1 (exploration): training proceeds from epoch 0 to epoch 10,000 using a cosine annealing scheduler with warm restarts ( CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts , T 0 = 50 T_{0}=50 , T mult = 2 T_{\text{mult}}=2 , η min = 10 − 10 \eta_{\min}=10^{-10} ). During this phase, additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) is sampled uniformly from σ ∈ [ 0 , 50 ] \sigma\in[0,50] . • Phase 2 (refinement): training continues from epoch 10,000 to epoch 20,000 starting from the best checkpoint obtained in Phase 1.
A step scheduler ( StepLR , step_size =2000, γ = 0.6 \gamma=0.6 ) is used in this phase.
The resulting models are referred to as flexible models , as they are trained to operate across a wide range of noise levels. • Phase 3 (noise-specific fine-tuning): from each flexible model, specialized variants are obtained for fixed noise levels σ ∈ { 5 , 15 , 25 , 35 } \sigma\in\{5,15,25,35\} by further fine-tuning from epoch 20,000 up to epoch 30,000, using the same step scheduler as in Phase 2.
These noise-specific models are referred to as fixed models , as they are optimized for a particular noise level.

After each training phase, we select the checkpoint that achieves the highest average PSNR on the validation split.
This model is then used to initialize the subsequent training stage, ensuring progressive refinement guided by validation performance.
blocks.zh:
在每个训练阶段后,我们选择在验证分拆上达到最高平均PSNR的检查站.
这一模式随后用于初始化后续培训阶段,确保以验证性能为指导逐步完善.

blocks.en:
We evaluate two parameterizations of DeepBM3D: a lightweight model with 890K parameters that surpasses classical BM3D, and a larger variant with 3.4M parameters that achieves further gains.
For each parameterization, we obtain both flexible models (trained across noise levels) and fixed models (fine-tuned for specific noise levels), resulting in four configurations: lightweight–flexible, lightweight–fixed, heavy–flexible, and heavy–fixed.
These variants form the basis for our experimental evaluation, which we compare against a range of existing methods described below.
blocks.zh:
我们评价DeepBM3D的两个参数化:一个具有890K参数的轻量级模型,超过了古典BM3D,另一个更大的变体,具有3.4M参数,可以实现进一步的增益.
对于每个参数化,我们既获得灵活的模型(在噪声水平上进行训练),也获得固定模型(对特定噪声水平进行精细调整),结果形成了四个配置:轻量级-弹性型,轻量级-固定型,重度-弹性型,重度-固定型。
这些变体构成我们实验评价的基础,我们与下文描述的一系列现有方法进行比较。

blocks.en: 5.3 Baselines and Comparison Methods
blocks.zh: 5.3 基线和比较方法

blocks.en: To assess the performance of DeepBM3D, we compare it against representative denoising methods spanning classical, hybrid, and deep learning paradigms. As a classical collaborative filtering reference, we include BM3D Dabov et al. (2007) , using the IPOL implementation Lebrun (2012) , and a DCT-based denoiser ( DCTDenoiser ) employed as a baseline in DCT2Net Herbreteau and Kervrann (2022) .
blocks.zh: 为了评估DeepBM3D的性能,我们把它与跨越古典、混合和深层学习范式的代名词方法进行比较。 作为典型的协作过滤参考,我们包括BM3D Dabov等人(2007年),使用IPOL执行Lebrun(2012年),以及DCT的Denoiser(DCTDenoiser)作为DCT2Net Herbreteau和Kervrann(2022年)的基线。

blocks.en: To bridge the gap between classical priors and data-driven learning, we also consider DCT2Net and its variant DCT/DCT2net Herbreteau and Kervrann (2022) , which extend classical DCT-based pipelines with trainable modules. These hybrid models retain part of the structure and interpretability of traditional methods while benefiting from optimization through learning. We evaluate them using the official pretrained weights released by the authors.
blocks.zh: 为了弥合古典前科和数据驱动学习之间的差距,我们还考虑DCT2Net及其变体DCT/DCT2net Herbreteau和Kervrann(2022年),它们延长了古典的DCT基于可训练模块的管道. 这些混合模型保留了传统方法的部分结构和可解释性,同时通过学习从优化中受益. 我们用提交人释放的官方预训重量来评价他们。

blocks.en: Finally, we include the deep learning method FFDNet Zhang et al. (2018) , a widely used denoiser trained end-to-end for grayscale AWGN removal with a noise-level map as input. For consistency, we also rely on the official pretrained weights provided by the authors.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们包括深层学习方法FFDNet Zhang等人(2018年),这是一个广泛使用的经培训的用于灰度AWGN清除的Denoiser端对端,以噪音级地图作为投入。 为了前后一致,我们还依靠作者提供的官方预先训练权重。

blocks.en: All baselines are evaluated under identical conditions using fixed noise levels σ ∈ { 5 , 15 , 25 , 35 } \sigma\in\{5,15,25,35\} . Whenever supported, models are provided with the exact noise-level map to ensure fair comparisons. This setup allows us to attribute performance differences to the models themselves rather than to discrepancies in evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都在同一条件下使用固定噪声水平 \\\ 5, 15, 25, 35}\ sigma\in\ 5, 15, 25, 35\\ 。 只要得到支持,就向模型提供准确的噪音级地图,以确保进行公平的比较。 这种设置使我们能够将性能差异归因于模型本身而不是评价协议的差异.

blocks.en: 6 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate the performance of DeepBM3D through quantitative and visual comparisons against baseline methods. We further analyze the impact of model capacity, training strategy, and architectural design choices through ablation studies.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们通过定量和视觉对比基准方法来评价DeepBM3D的性能. 我们通过开发研究,进一步分析模型能力、培训战略和建筑设计选择的影响。

blocks.en: 6.1 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 量化结果

blocks.en: Average PSNR results across four benchmark datasets and four standard noise levels are reported in Table 1 . DeepBM3D consistently improves upon classical and hybrid baselines, including BM3D, BM3D-Net, and the DCT2Net family, across most evaluated settings. This confirms the benefit of replacing handcrafted or partially learned components with fully differentiable modules while preserving the structural principles of collaborative filtering pipelines.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了四个基准数据集和四个标准噪音水平的PSNR平均结果。 DeepBM3D在经典和混合基线上不断改进,包括大多数评价的设置中的BM3D,BM3D-Net,以及DCT2Net家族. 这证实了在保留合作过滤管道的结构原则的同时,用完全不同的模块取代手工或部分学到的组件的好处。

blocks.en: Compared to BM3D-Net, which also follows a BM3D-inspired design, DeepBM3D achieves more stable performance across noise levels. While BM3D-Net performs competitively around its reference noise level ( σ = 15 \sigma=15 ), its performance degrades significantly for noise levels outside this range. In contrast, DeepBM3D maintains consistent behavior across all noise levels, both in its flexible and noise-specific variants.
blocks.zh: 与同样遵循BM3D启发式设计的BM3D-Net相比,DeepBM3D实现了更稳定的跨噪声级性能. 虽然BM3D-Net在参考噪声水平周围的竞争性表现(\ = 15\ sigma= 15),但其性能对于这个范围以外的噪声水平显著下降. 相比之下,DeepBM3D在所有噪声级别上都保持了一致的行为,无论是在其柔性和噪声特异性变体上都是如此.

blocks.en: Compared to FFDNet, which is a powerful, fully end-to-end learned model, DeepBM3D achieves competitive performance, particularly at low-to-moderate noise levels. In several cases (e.g., σ = 5 \sigma=5 and σ = 15 \sigma=15 ), our heavy fixed variant matches or slightly exceeds FFDNet, demonstrating the strength of our modular design despite the structural constraints imposed by collaborative transform-domain filtering. Notably, all predictions in DeepBM3D are produced through element-wise filtering in the transform domain, in contrast to the unconstrained nature of FFDNet.
blocks.zh: 与FFDNet相比,它是一个强大的,完全端到端的学习模型,DeepBM3D实现竞争性能,特别是在低度到中度噪音水平上. 在几种情况下(如:σ=5\sigma=5,σ=15\sigma=15),我们的重型固定变种匹配或略高于FFDNet,显示出我们模块化设计的力量,尽管合作变种域过滤带来的结构制约. 值得注意的是,DeepBM3D中的所有预测都是通过在变换域中进行元素筛选产生的,与FFDNet的无约束性质形成对比.

blocks.en: At higher noise levels ( σ ≥ 25 \sigma\geq 25 ), FFDNet maintains a more significant advantage, particularly on natural datasets such as Kodak and McMaster. This highlights the limitations of strongly structured filtering architectures under extreme noise conditions, where larger receptive fields and more expressive filtering become advantageous. Nevertheless, DeepBM3D remains competitive, and its interpretability and modularity make it an attractive alternative.
blocks.zh: 在更高的噪声水平(\\\sigma\geq 25)上,FFDNet保持了更显著的优势,特别是在Kodak和McMaster等自然数据集上. 这凸显了在极端噪声条件下结构严密的过滤架构的局限性,在这种条件下,更大的可接受域和更多的表达式过滤变得有利. 尽管如此,DeepBM3D仍然具有竞争力,其可解释性和模块性使它成为一个有吸引力的替代品.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning for fixed noise levels leads to consistent gains across all variants, with improvements of up to 0.2 dB compared to flexible training. The heavy fixed model achieves the highest scores overall, surpassing FFDNet in some settings and narrowing the gap in others. The lightweight models also perform remarkably well, showing that most performance gains can be achieved with compact architectures that retain the efficiency and modularity of collaborative filtering designs.
blocks.zh: 固定噪声水平的微调导致所有变种的一致增益,与灵活训练相比,改进度高达0.2分贝. 重型固定型号整体实现最高分数,在一些场合超过了FFDNet,在另一些场合缩小了差距. 轻量级模型也表现优异,显示大部分性能收益可以通过紧凑的架构来实现,这些架构保留了协作过滤设计的效率和模块性.

blocks.zh: 6.2 定性结果

blocks.en: We complement the quantitative evaluation with qualitative comparisons at representative noise levels. Figures 4 , 5 , 6 , and 7 illustrate visual results for σ ∈ { 5 , 15 , 25 , 35 } \sigma\in\{5,15,25,35\} , respectively.

blocks.en: Across the evaluated noise levels, DeepBM3D consistently outperforms BM3D, particularly at higher noise intensities where BM3D tends to produce structured artifacts such as blockiness or spurious lines. Our method preserves a cleaner appearance without introducing such distortions.
blocks.zh: 在整个评估的噪声水平上,DeepBM3D的性能始终高于BM3D,特别是在高噪声强度下,BM3D倾向于产生结构化的文物,如阻塞或假线. 我们的方法保持了更干净的外表,而没有造成这种扭曲。

blocks.en:
At low noise ( σ = 5 \sigma=5 , Figure 4 ), DeepBM3D achieves results on par with FFDNet in terms of both noise removal and detail preservation. At low-to-moderate noise levels ( σ = 15 \sigma=15 , Figure 5 ), our model shows clear advantages in reconstructing repetitive textures and high-frequency details. This is visible, for example, in the fine structures of the motorcycle spokes and forks.
Similar behavior on high-frequency repetitive details can be observed in Figure 6 .

blocks.en: At higher noise levels ( σ = 35 \sigma=35 , Figure 7 ), FFDNet retains a slight edge in preserving extremely fine details, yet DeepBM3D remains visually competitive, offering high-quality denoising with faithful structure reconstruction and effective suppression of noise. Overall, the combination of DCT-domain filtering and patch grouping yields visually compelling reconstructions across a wide range of noise conditions.
blocks.zh: 在更高的噪音水平(σ=35\sigma=35,图7)中,FFDNet在保存极细的细节方面保留了微弱的优势,然而DeepBM3D在视觉上仍然具有竞争力,以忠实的结构重建以及有效抑制噪音提供高质量的解诺. 总体而言,DCT域过滤和补丁组合的结合,在各种噪声条件下产生视觉上令人信服的重建。

blocks.en: 6.3 Texture Reconstruction Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.3 纹理重建分析

blocks.en: To further analyze the behavior of the proposed method, we evaluate its performance on structured textures from the Brodatz dataset. These images exhibit strong periodic patterns and non-local self-similarity, making them particularly suitable for assessing methods based on patch grouping and transform-domain filtering.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步分析拟议方法的行为,我们从布罗达兹数据集评价其结构化纹理的性能. 这些图像表现出强烈的周期性模式和非本地自我同质性,使得它们特别适合于基于补丁分组和变形域过滤的评估方法.

blocks.en: Quantitative results are reported in Table 2 . Figure 8 illustrates the texture images used for building this table. DeepBM3D consistently achieves superior PSNR values compared to FFDNet across all evaluated noise levels, which is not the case for general images as reported in Table 1 . The differences between the light and heavy versions are also narrower in the case of textures. These results highlight the advantage of combining non-local grouping and transform-domain filtering within a learnable framework for images with strong repetitive and oscillatory structure.

blocks.en: 6.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 6.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation experiments to analyze the contribution of key design choices in DeepBM3D .
These studies isolate the effect of individual components, such as the number of stages and the patch grouping configuration, providing insight into how each element influences denoising performance and visual quality.
blocks.zh:
分析DepenBM3D关键设计选择的贡献。
这些研究孤立了单个组件的作用,如阶段数和补丁分组配置,提供了对每个元素如何影响去诺化性能和视觉质量的洞察.

blocks.en:
To evaluate the contribution of the second stage in the DeepBM3D pipeline, we compare the performance of the single-stage and two-stage variants using the light flexible configuration. Quantitative results are reported in Table 3 .
Across all datasets and noise levels, the two-stage model consistently outperforms the single-stage counterpart, confirming the benefit of iterative refinement.
The improvement becomes more noticeable at higher noise levels, where the second stage effectively attenuates residual noise and reduces structured artifacts that may appear after the first filtering.
Qualitative results are shown in Figure 9 . It can be seen that the second stage produces smoother and more coherent textures, mitigating aliasing effects while preserving the overall structure and natural appearance of the image.
These findings support the use of a two-stage refinement strategy within the proposed differentiable framework, as it enhances stability and visual consistency.
blocks.zh:

在所有数据集和噪声水平上,两阶段模型的性能始终高于单阶段对应器,证实了迭代完善的好处.
在更高的噪音水平上,这种改进变得更加明显,第二阶段有效地减轻了残留噪音,减少了第一次过滤后可能出现的结构化文物。

这些调查结果支持在拟议的不同框架内采用两个阶段的完善战略,因为这样可以加强稳定性和视觉一致性。

blocks.en: The results in Table 4 , together with the visual summary in Figure 10 , show a clear and consistent improvement as the number of candidates increases. Across all datasets and noise levels, larger groups yield higher PSNR values, confirming that more extensive aggregation enhances the collaborative filtering stage. The effect is especially noticeable for low and medium noise levels ( σ ≤ 15 \sigma{\leq}15 ), where increasing N N from 8 to 32 provides gains of up to 0.5 dB, particularly on the McMaster and Kodak datasets. Although the relative improvement becomes smaller for higher noise levels, the trend remains monotonic across all cases.
blocks.zh: 表4中的结果以及图10中的视觉摘要显示,随着候选人人数增加,情况明显和持续改善。 在所有数据集和噪声水平上,较大的组产生更高的PSNR值,证实更广泛的聚合可以增强协作过滤阶段. 这种效应对中低噪音水平特别明显(15\\sigma\leq}15),其中NN从8到32的增益最高可达0.5分贝,特别是在麦克马斯特和科达克数据集. 虽然相对的改善因噪音水平较高而变得较小,但在所有情况下,这一趋势仍然是单一的。

blocks.en: Among the evaluated datasets, McMaster exhibits the greatest sensitivity to the number of candidates, suggesting that richly textured and colorful images benefit the most from dense patch grouping. The corresponding plot in Figure 10 illustrates this monotonic behavior, showing how each noise level consistently benefits from larger groups, although with diminishing returns. Moreover, the gains from N = 16 N{=}16 to N = 32 N{=}32 are not negligible, indicating that the model could achieve even higher performance with larger groups. However, increasing N N substantially raises the parameter count and computational cost during both training and inference.
blocks.zh: 在被评价的数据集中,麦克马斯特对考生数量表现出最大的敏感性,说明丰富的纹理和色彩丰富的图像从密集的补丁分组中受益最大. 图10中对应的情节说明了这种单调行为,显示了每个噪声水平如何始终从较大的群中得益,虽然回报率不断下降. 此外,从N=16 N{=}16到N=32 N{=}32的增益也不可忽略,表明该模式在较大群体中可以实现更高的性能. 然而,在培训和推论期间,增加NN大大增加参数计算和计算成本。

blocks.en: For this reason, we adopt N = 16 N{=}16 as a balanced configuration for our experiments, offering an excellent trade-off between denoising quality and efficiency. blocks.en: 6.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.5 限制

blocks.en: While DeepBM3D shows strong performance across most scenarios, its limitations become more apparent at higher noise levels. In such cases, the method tends to produce slightly blurrier results compared to fully end-to-end models such as FFDNet, as shown in Figure 11 .
blocks.zh: 虽然DeepBM3D在大多数情景中表现出强劲的性能,但其局限性在更高的噪音水平上变得更加明显. 在这种情况下,如图11所示,与诸如FFDNet等完全端到端模型相比,该方法往往产生略微模糊的结果。

blocks.en: This behavior is expected, as our architecture inherits certain structural constraints from BM3D. First, it operates on relatively small 3D blocks constructed from 5 × 5 5\times 5 patches, limiting the spatial context available during filtering. Second, the grouping stage is restricted to 15 non-local candidates plus the reference patch, which may be insufficient under severe noise. Lastly, the core filtering operation consists of an element-wise multiplication between the original patches and learned weights, providing a more constrained representation compared to the deeper convolutional architectures used in modern denoisers. These factors collectively constrain the model’s capacity, especially under challenging high-noise conditions.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的架构继承了BM3D的某些结构约束,因此这一行为是预期的. 首先,它运行在由5×5 5\time5补丁构建的相对较小的3D块上,限制了过滤时可用的空间上下文. 其次,分组阶段仅限于15名非当地候选人加上参考补丁,在严重噪音下可能不足. 最后,核心过滤操作由原始补丁和学习权重之间的元素相乘而成,相比现代登革热器中使用的更深层次的演化结构,提供了更受制约的表述. 这些因素共同制约了该模式的能力,特别是在具有挑战性的高噪音条件下。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced DeepBM3D, a fully differentiable architecture for collaborative transform-domain image denoising inspired by classical BM3D-style pipelines.
The proposed model combines non-local patch grouping, DCT-domain collaborative filtering, and multi-stage refinement within a unified trainable framework, replacing handcrafted operations with lightweight differentiable modules while preserving the structural principles of collaborative filtering methods.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了DeepBM3D,这是由古典BM3D风格的管道所启发的一种完全不同的合作变形域图像解诺的架构.
拟议模式结合非局部补丁分组,DCT域协同过滤,在统一的可训练框架内进行多阶段改进,以轻量级不同模块取代手工操作,同时保留协作过滤方法的结构原理.

blocks.en:
Experimental results show that DeepBM3D consistently improves over classical and hybrid baselines and remains competitive with modern deep denoisers such as FFDNet, despite relying on significantly stronger structural constraints.
In particular, the proposed architecture performs especially well on repetitive and oscillatory textures, suggesting that non-local grouping and DCT-domain filtering remain highly effective priors for structured image content.
blocks.zh:
实验结果显示,DeepBM3D在古典和混合基线上不断改进,尽管依赖于显著的更强大的结构限制,但仍与FFDNet等现代深层衍生物具有竞争力.
特别是,拟议的架构在重复和振荡纹理方面表现特别出色,表明非局部分组和DCT域过滤仍然是结构化图像内容的高度有效的前兆。

blocks.en:
At the same time, our experiments reveal the limitations of strongly structured transform-domain filtering architectures.
Under high noise conditions, restricted patch groups and localized filtering become less expressive than unconstrained deep models with larger receptive fields and higher representational capacity.
These observations provide insight into both the strengths and the limits of collaborative DCT-based denoising within modern learning frameworks.
blocks.zh:
同时,我们的实验揭示了结构化强的变电域过滤架构的局限性.
在噪音高的条件下,受限的补丁组和局部过滤变得不如具有较大可接受领域和更高代表性的不受约束的深层模型那样表现.
这些意见提供了对现代学习框架内基于DCT合作的取消提名的优点和局限性的见解。

blocks.en:
Overall, our results suggest that a substantial part of image denoising performance can still be explained through classical principles such as transform sparsity and non-local self-similarity.
Rather than replacing these ideas, deep learning can enhance them through differentiable optimization, enabling compact and interpretable architectures that remain competitive with significantly larger neural models.
Future work will investigate how far these structured approaches can be pushed through richer grouping strategies, adaptive transforms, and more expressive collaborative filtering mechanisms, particularly in challenging high-noise and real-world restoration scenarios.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,我们的结果表明,相当一部分图像消音性能仍然可以通过诸如变幻无常和非本地自我同化等经典原则来解释。
深刻的学习不是取代这些想法,而是可以通过不同的优化,使紧凑和可解释的架构与显著更大的神经模型保持竞争力来增强它们.
今后的工作将研究通过更丰富的分组战略、适应性转变和更具表现性的合作过滤机制,特别是在挑战性高噪音和现实世界的恢复情景中,这些结构化方法可在多大程度上得到推动。
